scope: Complete canonical catalog inventory; three detailed engine inspections and seven public rendered/pointer samples. Original Cojeev object treatments have separate native runtime and visual evidence.
verificationBoundaries: Discovery is complete against site catalog, src/data/components.ts, src/lib/registry.ts, and 35 route pages in pinned tree.
Source-inspected means one of the three detailed samples; downloading or mechanically extracting imports is not full source review.

Rendered means inspected real-browser output. Liquid, ASCII Object, Dithered Object, Ink Object, Glass Object, Liquid Object and Particle Object were individually rendered and pointer-operated. Selected source controls were also exercised. Public source inspection is distinct from native implementation verification.

Upstream WebGPU, reduced-motion, context-loss, mobile and broad keyboard/accessibility behavior were not audited. Specific public form controls were keyboard-operated for the material-object observations; original Cojeev implementations have separate runtime receipts.
Receipt source copies remain restricted upstream material; they are internal research evidence, not MIT implementation or distributable package content.
